selected_constraint: I1: mean of 0.5*(1-outward_normal dot outward_closure_axis) at two official close_fingers contacts
base_candidates: Existing final 1229 clean feasible/weak candidates; 641 feasible and 588 weak. Do not select on new outcomes.
angles: All 12 absolute EG angle classes; nominal rotation times Rx(class-minus-original)*15deg; nominal class kept bitwise original
fixed: candidate ID, score, center, approach, depth, width, object assignment, original final candidate membership
evaluation: Official continuous-pose collision/empty/get_grasp_score; no NMS or truncation applied to angle variants
I1_collision_policy: Recover contacts even on collided poses where possible; primary I1 selection does NOT consult collision, empty or mu labels
missing_contact_policy: I1 undefined, excluded from conditional expected risk; report missing mass and cases separately, not imputed feasible
primary_selection: minimum I1 over all 12 classes, keep nominal class on ties; GT-contact oracle, not inference algorithm
secondary_selection: minimum I1 in +/-1 and +/-2 cyclic neighboring classes; report all, do not choose best setting post hoc
physical_oracle: best feasible/lowest-mu clean class, explicitly separate upper bound
gradient: softmax(logits/temperature) expected detached I1 over contact-defined classes; primary temperature 1; analytic p*(risk-mean)/T checked by autograd and finite difference
logit_probe: One ephemeral normalized negative-gradient displacement with max absolute logit change 0.25/0.5/1.0, main 0.5; not a parameter update, not a learned/deployable result
model_realized: Frozen original EG argmax, no training. Thus unchanged actual model outputs; logit probes are GT-assisted attainability only
decision_gate: Proceed to training only if primary I1 selection and main logit probe yield positive scene-bootstrap net feasible change; weak recovery positive and collision/empty increase and feasible-harm rate each <=5 percentage points. These are operational conservative gates fixed before evaluation, not significance guarantees.
statistics: Paired scene units; 10000 bootstrap draws within seen/similar/novel strata; equal scene weighting; 48 frames are not independent scenes
training: No training in experiments 1/2. Experiment3 conditional on gate and a fully specified common training budget; do not run if HOLD/STOP.
numerical_note: Set before aggregate analysis after nominal cross-host contact differences of order 1e-9; preserve nominal class for numerically tied I1; physical quality and GO gates unchanged.
